instructions: Log in to the custom_or_unknown admin interface and navigate to the 'Settings' tab.
Click on 'Custom Code' and select 'Add a new code snippet'.
In the 'Code snippet' field, paste the following HTML code for the returns reason capture form:
<input type='text' id='other-reason' name='other-reason' placeholder='Please specify reason'>
In the 'Placement settings' field, select 'After checkout' as the placement option.
Click 'Save' to save the code snippet.
To display the returns reason capture form on the returns page, navigate to the 'Returns' tab and click on 'Edit return flow'.
In the 'Return flow' editor, click on the '+' icon to add a new step.
